summary: Slap bass: percussive, bright thumb and pop, funk
label: slap bass
body: Short octave-jumping 16ths, ghost notes; leaves room for the kick.

Register: MIDI 28-55 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Slap Bass 1, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Slap Bass 1") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
